title: ImplementationPlan
description: The ordered binding of work items to work packages. Written to init/plan/plan.md (front-matter is this object). The plan transition also seeds init/product/open/<id> markers — one per package — that the advance transition consumes as the unforgeable 'work remaining' guard.

id.description: Stable lowercase-kebab slug for the package.

work_items.description: Ids of work items (under init/product/) this package delivers.

order.description: Execution order; lower runs first. Ties may run in parallel.

budget.description: Optional per-package budget estimate (folds into orchestrator Limits.Budget).
